verdict.rationale: Fern's docs reference reader feedback, search queries, and general 'analytics' as inputs to Fern Agent automations, and reader activity is exposed via MCP and the llms.txt analytics tab (traffic by LLM provider), suggesting a DevRel lead could see these signals. However, there's no direct documentation of a dedicated page-view dashboard or explicit analytics UI screenshots. Missing for 10: explicit page-view metrics/dashboard documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of the analytics interface.
